sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fromMaybe function, which provides a default when something is absent — and the type Nothing representing absence
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone who may not be there, you always fall back to yourself.
sketches.draft:
home :: Maybe a -> a
home = fromMaybe undefined

alone = home Nothing

sketches.mechanism: A static local variable persists across function calls — it remembers between invocations even when everything else on the stack is destroyed
sketches.resonance: The body forgets, but the wound keeps counting.

sketches.mechanism: A sealed trait with pattern matching that is exhaustive — the compiler forces you to handle every case, including the one you want to ignore
sketches.resonance: You must face every possibility; the language will not let you look away.
sketches.draft:
sealed trait Ending
case object Yours extends Ending
case object Mine extends Ending
case object Ours extends Ending

def face(e: Ending): Unit = e match {
  case Yours => ()
  case Mine  => ()
  case Ours  => ()
}
